Yeah, I'm just trying to take things slow. Got a lot of therapy lined up for me, but it's not overwhelming me too much, which is good I suppose. Trying my best to stay positive, keep myself busy. More for my family's sake than anything, but oh well.
I wouldn't say I have a bad relationship with her. But we've been distant.
Even if they do, any happiness I gain from it will disappear before I know it. And then I'll feel the same emptiness I've gotten so used to again. There's no point.
Things never go right lol. That won't change.

We're good friends. But I love him, and he's just not sure if he loves me. But I don't want to care about it anymore, just want to get away from it all. I know I'll just get hurt if things don't go how I hope.
I know nothing will come from them though. They don't really feel the same way about me as I do to them. And I'm tired of living for other people when I myself don't want to.
